status: Fixed before examination of BUB1B expression effects; dataset schema and study methods inspected first. Exploratory follow-up after v29, not external preregistration.
question: Does independent public CRISPRi evidence support a BUB1B perturbation model in non-cancer RPE1 cells, and what contradicts transfer from tumour-cell transcriptomic findings?

data.inputs: Original raw single-cell, raw pseudobulk and normalized pseudobulk AnnData files; public reference experiments only.
data.provenance: Provider MD5 where available, source bytes, local SHA256, full metadata and observed schema retained. RPE1 raw single-cell provider MD5 is missing, not verified.

metadata_audit: Count distinct target constructs, actual guide annotations, cells and gemgroups for every query; paired guides in one construct are one perturbation.
Preserve transcript-start-site and construct labels; do not pool alternate constructs as independent replicates.
Identify whether exported raw single-cell matrix is already QC-filtered; use original cell metadata and report selection limits.
Compare original provider target knockdown and cell-cycle/CNV summary columns, explicitly separating published estimates from newly calculated measurements.

primary_analysis.normalization: Log1p CP10k from nonnegative count input, subtract same-gemgroup mean of core non-targeting controls. Fixed fallback is no evaluable effect if a relevant gemgroup has fewer than 20 control cells; never silently borrow a different batch.
primary_analysis.feature_selection: Common measured genes with mean raw counts >=0.25 in core controls of both cell lines. Selection excludes target effects. Remove all ten queried genes from the primary specificity features; retain all-feature sensitivity.
primary_analysis.constructs: At least 30 retained cells, exact gene_transcript label; absent or under-covered targets are missing, not zero.
primary_analysis.profiles: Mean centered single-cell vectors by construct. Pearson correlation across features. Full target panels retained, no top-hit-only output.
primary_analysis.target_knockdown: Ratio of mean CP10k target expression to gemgroup-matched controls with reported counts and unnormalized UMI sensitivity; transcript knockdown is not protein depletion or functional qualification.
primary_analysis.same_cell_specificity: Stratified random half-splits within construct and gemgroup. Retrieve each held-out half from all opposite halves; record both directions, same-target correlations, reference denominator, complete per-query distributions and full-panel aggregate retrieval.
primary_analysis.cross_cell_specificity: Compare exact shared construct labels and gene-level unambiguous matches between RPE1 and K562. Preserve unequal time, effector, culture and p53 context; correlation is not equal function.
primary_analysis.null: Equal-size control-cell pseudo-perturbations matched to query gemgroup counts, sampled without replacement where feasible. Controls for null effects use disjoint reference halves to avoid guaranteed zero by self-centering. Retain finite-reference resolution and dependence.
primary_analysis.resampling: 1024 split-half replicates per cell/control view in two fixed seed blocks of 512. Cells are subsamples, not independent experiments. Quantiles describe conditional resampling stability, not biological confidence intervals.
primary_analysis.cell_cycle: Compare published cell-cycle metadata if available. Sensitivity excludes the fixed Seurat S/G2M gene list. This removes potentially causal biology and is not a causal adjustment.
primary_analysis.control_sensitivity: Repeat with all annotated non-targeting controls rather than provider-selected core controls. Report disagreement; core selection can make nulls optimistic.
primary_analysis.sampling_sensitivity: Leave-one-gemgroup-out query profiles where remaining target/control coverage is adequate; sequencing partitions are not biological replicates.

compute.allocation: Two cell types by two control views by two seed blocks, one worker per GPU.
compute.precision: CUDA FP32 with TF32 disabled; selected operations compared with CPU FP64 at absolute tolerance 2e-5.
compute.reproduction: Retain source receipts, pinned environment lock, executed scripts, numerical checks, GPU monitoring, failed attempts and complete outputs. No sustained-utilization claim without telemetry.

falsifiers: Absent BUB1B coverage, poor target suppression or inconsistent effects across available constructs prevents qualification.
Apparent specificity that disappears with query-transcript removal, all-control sensitivity or partition exclusion weakens attribution.
Cross-cell disagreement or cell-cycle dependence weakens direct transfer from the LINCS tumour models.
Strong generic essential-gene responses or negative-control false matches prevents selective pathway interpretation.
No independent construct/restoration, no drug-plus-deficit data and no direct division/fate outcomes means no functional-rescue or clinical claim regardless of statistical result.

decision_contract.maximum_supported_update: Refine non-cancer assay model and controls; downgrade or retain tumour-to-non-cancer extrapolation.

limitations: RPE1 is immortalized retinal epithelium, not the child's kidney, muscle or developmental tissue.
Generic transcriptional CRISPRi depletion does not recreate the selected alleles.
Survivor and QC selection, pooled culture, off-target repression, shared control selection and library batch effects remain.
RNA-derived CNV and cell-cycle labels are estimates, not independently measured karyotype, division fidelity or tissue function.
Shared guides across cell types and many cell subsamples do not provide independent biological replication.
